text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Good luck to us both today. I'll see you on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm looking forward to running with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Sprinters Stakes. Since it's Nishino Flower's first time running it, many senior racers are stopping by to wish her luck.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: She was so big and muscular…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sprinters generally put on a lot of muscle. The longer their careers, the truer this becomes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was just wondering if my size is going to affect my race results even more than usual…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You told me I'd be able to shine in sprints, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did my absolute best at summer camp, and I thought I'd improved. I was determined to win today, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Am I really going to be okay? If I fail this, then I'll…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm emphatic in my reassurance. She's gotten this far by staying true to herself. That doesn't need to change.
choice_data_list: Believe in yourself and how hard you've worked to get here.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But…
choice_data_list: If you can't do that, then believe in me!
If you can't do that, then believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: You'll become the best sprinter there is!
You'll become the best sprinter there is!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so? In that case…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can do it! Or at least… I want to believe that I can.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No! I do believe I can!
choice_data_list: Go out there, and make me smile!
Go out there, and make me smile!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower! You're here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You may have left me in the dust—or maybe it's sand? You may have left me in the sand at summer camp, but today will be different!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Today, I will be the winner!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I cannot agree with that statement. After all, I will be the one who embraces the breeze at the front of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Last year, I suffered a bitter defeat. This time, I won't let anyone stand in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …! That was Trainer's voice…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale… Right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I won't let you… beat me either!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win!
